prompt:
Create exactly ONE faithful architectural stage master for AYA in MASS EFFECT ANDROMEDA by matching the attached actual game screenshot's scene, geometry, camera, lighting and framing as precisely as possible. The specific place is the EXTENDABLE EMBARKATION BRIDGE at the TEMPEST'S DEDICATED BERTH, viewed toward the entry plaza of Aya during the first arrival. This is a recreation of THIS EXACT VIEW, not a design prompt for a generic Angaran dock. Do not move the camera or extend the scene. The Tempest is off camera on the right in this composition; do not add a ship into the picture.

Preserve the screenshot's 16:9 composition and all fixed architecture. The broad segmented metal bridge runs diagonally across the foreground from the lower right edge to the left midground docking pylon. Its floor has large dark gray rectangular telescoping panels with narrow black seams and low pale gray segmented outer curbs. The near bridge side has horizontal grooves, clamps and the prominent circular mechanical joint near the lower center. The left end meets a tall rectangular pale pylon with rounded edges, a deep glossy black horizontal band around its lower middle, and a pale lower extension hanging down. Keep the diagonal structural struts under the bridge and the long hanging vines beneath the platform. There is a deep shadowy water/chasm space below, not a solid ground floor.

In the midground preserve the metal lattice guardrails with irregular angular openings around the landing terraces, the low pale retaining walls, square planters and dense dark green alien broadleaf plants. Preserve the small blue cyan wall indicators and the short vertical blue-gray device at the bridge's far landing. In the background preserve the huge pale gray vertical panel facade on the right with blue horizontal bands on its columns, repeating cyan-lit alcoves, thin suspended vertical fixtures and long fabric banners in muted red/brown and dark blue carrying subtle alien geometric marks. There are two prominent downward pointed X/V-shaped fixed facade ornaments beneath the lit alcoves; copy their placements. Upper right has a guarded balcony with two dark red-brown structures behind its rail, and a tall narrow blue-marked vertical panel on the far right. Upper architecture is naturally cropped exactly as in the photograph. On the left preserve the tall pale waterfall and dark mossy rock wall recessed behind the terraces. Match the blue-gray diffuse shaded atmosphere, subtle warm illumination on the bridge panels, subdued vegetation and actual game's material level. No dramatic relighting, no orange sunset, no neon redesign, no added buildings, arches, towers or weapons.

Remove every living character from the screenshot: no Ryder, no companions, no Angaran greeting party, no silhouettes or people behind the railings. Carefully restore their small occluded patches only by continuing the already visible bridge panel seams, railing patterns and wall/floor materials at those exact positions. Preserve all other architecture and plants. No HUD, reticle, subtitles, captions, border, logos or added text. Remove transient flying leaves/sparks, keep only scene atmosphere. Do not add small Angaran shuttles, the Tempest hull or another landing pad. Render one complete opaque landscape image, no transparency, no collage, no extra angle. It is a single static reference-faithful stage illustration, not an expanded map or gameplay redesign.
